text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle put on a great performance in 
the Aoi Stakes. To repay everyone, she 
expresses her desire to run in the Summer 
Sprint next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although it's a graded stakes campaign 
within her optimal distance of 
1,000–1,200m, her Trainer was worried 
about the rapid succession of back-to-back 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, to answer the wishes of the girl 
who was beginning to gain confidence, 
taking 1st place in the Hakodate Sprint 
Stakes was set as her next goal.
